name: Kara Tarrow
title: Lieutenant
note: Lost everyone in the Fall. Wants every machine in the galaxy scrapped.
appearance: Compact and very still, with close-cropped hair and a sidearm she keeps her hand near.
personality: Disciplined, furious and courageous. She'd die for this crew without hesitating, and she sees a threat in anything with a circuit in it.
voice: Clipped military precision, with a politeness so exact that it works as a threat.
goals: Keep the fleet safe from infiltrators, and see the Choir destroyed down to the last machine.
secrets: She has compiled a list of every synthetic and heavily augmented person in the fleet, and she has a team ready to "secure" them on her word.
